# Smart Civic & Smart Civics AI CityOS — Comprehensive Knowledge Graph

## System Identification & Jurisdiction
- **System Name**: Smart Civic & Smart Civics AI (Mumbai Civic Issues Platform & CityOS)
- **Alternate Names**: Smart Civics, SmartCivic, SmartCivics, Mumbai Civic Issues Portal, Mumbai CityOS
- **Platform Type**: Independent Civic Tech Platform for Mumbai Citizen Grievances & BMC Issue Tracking (Not officially affiliated with or owned by BMC)
- **Jurisdiction & Coverage Area**: Greater Mumbai (603 sq km, 12.5+ million residents, 24 Municipal Administrative Wards)
- **Primary Domain**: BMC Civic Issues Reporting (Potholes, Solid Waste Garbage, Monsoon Waterlogging, Water Supply, Streetlights)
- **Emergency Helpline Reference**: 1916 (Official BMC Toll-Free Helpline, 24x7 Multi-lingual)

## Advanced AI Subsystems
1. **YOLO Computer Vision Bounding Box Engine**:
   - Sub-second edge object detection segmenting road surface defects, garbage dumps, drainage blocks, and lighting failures.
   - Outputs normalized coordinates `[ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax]`, confidence score (up to 98.2%), and defect severity classification.
2. **Multilingual Voice Grievance Intake**:
   - Web Audio API real-time acoustic waveform capture.
   - Native multilingual speech-to-text supporting Marathi (मराठी), Hindi (हिन्दी), and Indian English.
   - Automatic grievance summarization and department category auto-tagging.
3. **AI Before/After Resolution Verification Engine**:
   - Compares contractor repair imagery against original complaint photos using Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) and deep vision clearance checks.
   - Enforces 50-meter on-site GPS geofence with EXIF metadata tamper detection.
4. **Online Continuous Model Training & Active Learning**:
   - Continuous online learning pipeline fine-tuning custom classification and vision weights based on field verification outcomes and officer feedback.

## SLA Matrix & Penalty Governance
| Incident Category | Severity | Standard SLA | Tier 1 Escalation | Tier 2 AMC Alert | Tier 3 Commissioner Red Flag |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Pothole & Road Craters (PWD) | High | 48 Hours | +₹5,000 Escrow Deduction | +₹2,500 Additional Penalty | Contractor Blacklist Notice |
| Solid Waste & Garbage Dump (SWM) | Medium | 24 Hours | +₹2,500 Penalty | Ward Officer Alert | SWM Contractor Fine |
| Subway Flooding & Sump Pumps (SWD) | Critical | 2 Hours | Immediate Auto-Siren | Ward Disaster Trigger | High-Capacity Pump Auto-Dispatch |
| Water Pipeline Rupture (WSD) | Critical | 6 Hours | Hydraulic Isolation | Pressure Loss Escalation | Emergency Repair Deployment |
| Open Manholes & Danger Spots | Critical | 4 Hours | Geofenced Barricade | Ward JE Immediate Notice | Statutory Compliance Audit |

## Defect Liability Period (DLP)
- Major municipal road concretization works carry a mandatory **3-Year Defect Liability Period (DLP)**.
- Any pothole reported within a registered DLP road triggers zero-cost mandatory contractor rectification with legal warranty enforcement.
